key_concepts: Matter is anything that occupies space and has mass.
Matter exists in three states: solid, liquid, and gas.
Solids have closely packed molecules, limited movement, and definite shape.
Liquids have loosely packed molecules, some movement, and no definite shape.
Gases have molecules far apart and maximum freedom to move.
Volume is the amount of space occupied by an object or substance.
Matter occupies space, and no two matter can occupy the same space at the same time.
Matter has mass, which is different from weight.
Liquids and gases take the shape of their containers.
Matter has texture, which can be rough or smooth.
